title: SGA 5 and SGA 6: Modern LaTeX Working Editions, English Translations, Source Repair, and Audit Materials
version: 2026-07-18 SGA 6 French source-rescribe checkpoint through idx684
description:
This is the reader-facing SGA working record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. It contains modern LaTeX working editions, machine-assisted English and Spanish translations, French source-repair workpasses, high-resolution source witnesses, and audit material for SGA 5 and SGA 6.

Open first: 00_SGA5_English_SourceChecked_WorkingTranslation_NotCritical_20260717.pdf, the current 309-page source-aware SGA 5 English working translation. For SGA 6 English, open 02_SGA6_English_FullRange_Layered_WorkingReader_CORRECTED_20260718.pdf, a 381-page layered working reader covering the full extant source scan. For the current French source-rescribe checkpoint, open 01_SGA6_French_SourceRescribe_Workpass_NotCertified_idx684_20260718.pdf.

Current French update: the linear pagewise pass has reached source idx684 / volume p. 671 / Expose XIV p. 5, with idx685 next. This adds twenty-two processed source pages beyond the preceding public idx662 freeze. The grouped ZIP contains editable release and upstream TeX, the complete pagewise repair ledger, errata, the high-resolution idx663-684 source delta, boundary witnesses, source-to-output render checks, compile evidence, and checksums. The frontier page includes the correction of the inherited erroneous A^2(Z)=Pic(Z) to the source-visible A^1(Z)=Pic(Z). Explicit deferred systematic and page-spanning issues remain in the ledger; idx684 is a processing cursor, not a whole-volume certification boundary.

SGA 6 English authority layers: source-PDF 001-525 uses an inherited English control that is partially source-synchronized but not globally source-checked; idx532-662 / source-PDF 526-656 is source-checked against the directly checked French workpass for that range; idx663-702 / source-PDF 657-692 and terminal source-PDF 693-702 are a scan-checked English draft pending later French-source reconciliation. A bounded Spanish Expose X working tranche for idx532-537 / printed pp. 519-524 is also retained.

Scope: these are substantive machine-assisted, source-aware working editions and translations, not OCR-only output. They are not independently human-certified critical editions, whole-SGA completion claims, whole-volume source-faithfulness certifications, publication-grade proofread editions, or diagram-by-diagram certifications. SGA 5 retains known residual errors. Corrections can be proposed through the GitHub mirror.
notes: Reader-first SGA 5 and SGA 6 working surface. The SGA 6 French pagewise source-rescribe cursor is idx684, with explicit deferred issues and inherited unchecked scaffold after the cursor. The SGA 6 English reader uses separated authority layers. Not a completed or critical edition, whole-volume source-faithfulness certification, or diagram-by-diagram certification.
